title: A record
description: What one start of a role, or the orchestrator of a run, carried out, in the order it did: each step of its prompt once the step's result held, and each practice of a best practice while it carried the practice out, with the result that rn's check kept once it passed the end. record.py decides this form: record.py add writes the entries, and record.py check reads them at a role's end, or at each end of the orchestrator's turn, and keeps the result.

entries.description: Each step and practice, in the order recorded, as the check reads each practice by where it falls among the steps.

of.description: The prompt that holds the step, by its role, such as generator, or by its command.

step.description: The step's number in the prompt's Steps.

of.description: The best practice that holds the practice, by its kind, such as code.

practice.description: The practice's ID, its condition's ID and its place, such as N6.2.

kept.description: The result that the start gave, kept by record.py check once it passed the end, so that the adapter of rn's records gives Lane the results of a run to pick up. Absent until then.

role.description: The role that gave the result, such as generator.

result.description: The fixed word the role gave by Lane's result script, such as done.

gave.description: What the step left, or what the practice gave, in a line, so that the orchestrator checks the result against it.
